reason: A VS Code integration for embedding the DSH WebUI, monitoring its availability, managing its service process, and displaying controls and logs within the editor.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH WebUI 嵌入 VS Code，并提供服务状态监控、进程启停、配置控制和日志查看功能。
summaries.en: Embeds the DSH WebUI in VS Code with service monitoring, process controls, configuration options, and log viewing.

capabilities: Embeds a configurable DSH WebUI URL in a VS Code webview
Monitors service availability through periodic HTTP requests
Starts and stops a configurable background command as a child process
Captures child-process stdout and stderr in VS Code output channels
Opens the configured service URL in the system browser
